details: react-bootstrap-table2-toolkit-bg is a dependency-confusion package: it was published on 2026-11-07 with the inflated version 9.9.9 to win version resolution over a private package of the same name. Both its `preinstall` and `postinstall` scripts run `node beacon.js`, which sends an HTTP GET over cleartext HTTP to the hardcoded IP endpoint `http://100.24.177.136/cb` with the package name, the machine's hostname, the OS user name, the current working directory and the platform as query parameters. The file calls itself an "AUTHORIZED dependency-confusion PoC". The package has no other code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder version carries no install script and is not affected. Any machine that installed 9.9.9 has disclosed its hostname, user name and filesystem layout to a third party; remove the package, pin or scope internal package names to the internal registry, and block 100.24.177.136 on build hosts.
